justification.howDistrictMembershipBinds: Texas TCEQ water-district / MUD membership for a customer-facing claim is whether the parcel intersects the district polygon. Tax and service geography attach when any portion of the parcel lies in the district; adjacency without intersection does not.
justification.straddlingParcelCustomerClaim: A parcel that straddles a district boundary MUST read as PRESENT for that district (one present atom per intersecting districtId). Emitting ABSENT because a proxy point missed the polygon is a silent false negative — the SF-6 class. ST_Intersects includes the boundary, which is correct for continuous district geography (a parcel on the line is in).
justification.multiMembership: Unchanged: one present atom per (parcel, districtId); absence atom only when zero districts intersect.
justification.mudRail: A-002: mud is a special-district TYPE; special-district-fact serves the mud rail; district_type is body subcategorization; no mud-specific writer

emptyDistrictSetCountingRule.interpretation: TCEQ is a statewide source. Zero district polygons attributed to the county is a POSITIVE determination from that source, not a missing ingest and not an unknown.

emptyDistrictSetCountingRule.reasonMustState: Reason text MUST say the statewide TCEQ layer contains zero district polygons attributed to this county FIPS (positive source finding). An empty result labeled absence WITHOUT that reasoning is the defect class this program keeps finding.
